Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the product deep-dive with us this morning — great discussion and especially helpful to hear the compliance constraints you flagged. Per our call, I wanted to recap agreed next steps and capture a concrete list of artifacts your security team typically requests so we can turn around the evidence quickly.

Quick recap (from our side):
- You’re evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference on PHI-adjacent telemetry (HIPAA scoping: limited PHI touchpoints, may require BAAs for certain integrations).
- GDPR jurisdiction applies to a subset of users; you requested our data residency and deletion controls.
- SOC 2: you asked whether we have Type II evidence and what’s included in our report.
- Incident response & breach notification: you want a sample incident timeline and confirmation on our notification SLAs and escalation contacts.
- BCP/DR: you're interested in our failover testing documentation and recovery RTO/RPO targets.

To keep momentum, can you confirm the list below is what your security/compliance reviewer wants? If you need anything else, drop it in your reply. If this list looks right, we’ll prioritize delivery by the dates suggested on the right.

Requested items (your ask -> suggested Redwood delivery):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (scope & controls summary) -> Redwood to provide redacted report + control matrix by 2026-12-17
2) Data processing addendum / GDPR controls and data residency notes -> 2026-12-17
3) BAA draft (if HIPAA applies) -> 2026-12-20
4) Incident Response runbook excerpt (notification timeline, sample notification templates, escalation path) -> 2026-12-15 (we can get a prioritized pack sooner if needed)
5) BCP/DR test matrix (last test date, outcome, RTO/RPO) -> 2026-12-15
6) Vendor security questionnaire answers (we can start with a completed short-form and follow with attachments) -> 2026-12-17

Attached are three quick artifacts we commonly share to accelerate reviews: a SOC2 summary (redacted), a sample IR runbook excerpt, and our BCP matrix. These are placeholders — I’ll attach the official files once our security team finalizes redactions.

Please let me know: 1) any additions to the list; 2) the name/email of the reviewer who will own the intake; and 3) any firm deadlines for procurement or legal signoff.

Best,

David Kim

David — thanks for the clear recap and the placeholder artifacts. Quick answers from our side to keep things moving: 

- SOC 2: our security team needs the Type II report (redacted ok) plus a control mapping for encryption, logging, incident response, and access controls.
- GDPR: please include your data retention limits, deletion process, and subprocessors list.
- HIPAA: CloudCrest stores some PHI in a separate ingestion path; our legal team will advise if a BAA is mandatory, but could you draft a BAA so we can review?
- IR/Breach notifications: we will need your sample timeline showing detection -> triage -> customer notification windows, and a named escalation contact (phone + backup).
- BCP/DR: confirm last failover test date and whether you use automated cross-region failover for the inference runtime.

Timeline: our reviewer (security intake) needs materials by EOD 2026-12-20 to keep the quarter procurement review on track. If you can deliver the IR timeline and BCP testing evidence by 2026-12-15, that would be ideal.

One more ask: we prefer artifacts shared via a secure link (we can provide SSO-linked Drive). Is that possible? If so, send the upload link and I’ll share with security.

Thanks — looking forward to the docs.

Alice Nguyen
